testcase.name: open chat of another contact does not suppress the badge
first delivery is saved once with remoteMessageId and acknowledged
duplicate by remoteMessageId does not create a second record but is acknowledged again
duplicate message does not increment the unread badge again
new message increments the contact unread badge
message arriving while that chat is open does not increment the badge but is still saved and acknowledged
different messageIds from the same contact are all saved
same remoteMessageId from a different contact is a different message
